name: ds-hakkard
english_description: A custom closed-alpha game -- self-titled 'Hakkard World,' banner reads 'Revision 0.0.1, Status: Closed Alpha' -- built on the Dead Souls 3.8.6 engine this collection already hosts as ds386/deadsouls_fluffos/dsIII. Its non-secure stock code (command dispatch, headers, the campus/cave/default/examples/learning/Praxis/town/Ylsrim demo domains) is close to byte-identical to ds386's own raw archive; what makes it a real game rather than another stock copy are three bespoke domains built on top. The town of Lennar centers on Everett Square, where Elma Street crosses Main Street past a statue amid 'the hustle and bustle of everyday life,' with an Adventurer's Guild ('several people mill around, with wicked-looking weapons strapped to themselves'), a Mage's Guild, and named NPCs like Clerebold Vance, a small but exceptionally fit man whose Stetson hat is 'riddled with cuts and holes.' Lennar Manor is a separate noble estate with its own reception hall, tea room, lower library, and barracks; Northern Wastes is a third, frozen area (furnace, freezer, void rooms) built on the same engine. A personal builder's workroom (realms/muirrum) holds several in-progress test rooms and abandoned editor scratch buffers -- a snapshot of a game still under active construction. Distinctively, the public repo's own .gitignore had excluded the entire secure/ security-daemon tree plus the top-level /log and /save runtime directories from git history outright; this port supplied secure/ from ds386's own already driver-compat-fixed copy (confirmed byte-identical wherever the two overlap) and recovered /log and /save, whose absence turned out to matter even more -- it had made the driver's own error handler crash while logging routine compile warnings, silently miscategorizing ~35 harmless files as hard batch-compile failures. 2,432 of 2,440 files pass a full compile sweep (99.7%); makes three real outbound network connections at boot (IMC2, Intermud-3, an automatic dead-souls.net RELEASE_NOTES fetch) -- do not sweep this lib into high-frequency automated re-boot loops. Verified live end to end: the first-boot admin installer, admin login into a wizard workroom, ordinary new-player registration (8-race pick, age gate), a distinct reconnect path, and look/score/update/quit. See NOTES.md for the full porting log.
